newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT, according to analysts.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.400 to up 0.500 cent. Carryover stops possible but market said to overreact to BSE rumor and seen rebounding.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.300 cent. Oversold on spillover from live cattle and corn futures seen lower.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.200 to 0.300 cent. Higher cash hog markets on strong packer demand.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.500 to 1.000 cent. Confirmed Japan buying interest and technically strong.
